system.description: The Visc, short for Violet Scales, are cold-blooded humanoid reptiles marked by their shimmering violet hides.

attribution.source: The New Unknown Playtest v2.0 Mind

system.gmNotes: PT3 prints a generic Visc entry with a caste-born top feature (depends on caste) and Hard to Kill; that entry is covered by the three caste ancestries.
